technique_name: Describe the impact cell phones have had on communication
description: The advent of cell phones has decidedly changed the landscape of communication. The ability to communicate digitally over wireless networks has enabled us to communicate faster and more efficiently with one another. Cell phones have also made communication more accessible to those who were previously unable to make calls due to cost or geography.
